key_concepts: Magnetic separation is a technique for separating metals from non-metals.
The separation method used depends on the type of mixture.
No chemical reaction is involved in magnetic separation.
Metals made of alloy, nickel, or cobalt are easily attracted to a magnet.
Non-metals are not attracted to a magnet.

Mixtures of metal and nonmetal objects can be separated using a magnet.
A magnet can be used to find or remove metal objects mixed with nonmetal materials.
Magnetic separation can be applied in everyday life and community activities.
